purpose: Public-safe family ownership and boundary contract shared by foundation, operations, and extractor-mapper.

must_not_own: public contract implementations that belong to foundation

dependency_rule.rule: The arrows describe contract and result flow, not unrestricted source imports.
dependency_rule.public_to_private_rule: foundation never depends on private repositories or protected implementation.

single_owner_rule: One repository is authoritative for each behavior. Compatibility exports may preserve old interfaces but may not duplicate algorithms.
change_method: locate the canonical symbol or contract
run the family overlap audit when ownership or cross-repo structure changes
remove duplicate implementations after parity evidence
non_negotiable_rules: do not create a second authority for the same policy or resource
do not copy extraction or mapping algorithms into operations
do not move private policy into public foundation
do not put chatbot algorithms into extractor-mapper
do not make mapping perform network I/O
do not expose credentials, protected topology, or evaluation holdouts through public contracts
do not add new business logic to immutable legacy snapshots

validation.repository_local: Each repository owns and runs its own compile, test, security, and contract checks.
validation.family_overlap: Operations owns the cross-repository overlap audit because it is the protected family control plane.
validation.deep_audit: The family overlap audit is periodic and exhaustive; local CI should remain bounded and deterministic.
